newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-WEEKEND PROGRAMME IN THE GERMAN LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEEKEND PROGRAMME IN THE GERMAN LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: The following Bundesliga matches are scheduled to take place this weekend:
Champions Dortmund ravaged by injuries to likes of libero Matthias Sammer and striker Karlheinz Riedle take on promoted local rivals hoping to maintain bright start to season.
Leaders Stuttgart welcome back Bulgarian playmaker Krassimir Balakov from injury while Swiss international Alain Sutter returns for struggling Freiburg.
Leverkusen coach Christoph Daum must do without suspended striker Ulf Kirsten but has no injury worries. Hansa still looking for first Bundesliga win over Leverkusen.
Under-pressure St Pauli coach Uli Maslo desperately needs win against surprisingly resillient Duesseldorf side.
Moenchengladbach must do without midfielder Peter Nielsen, on international duty for Denmark. 1860 confident, having won both their games with Moenchengladbach last season.

Pressure on Schalke players to produce victory after their discontent with coach Joerg Berger cost him his job on Thursday. Bundesliga leading scorer, the South African Sean Dundee looking to add to his eight-goal tally for Karlsruhe.
Bottom side Bielefeld still looking for first league win after eight games. Rapidly-improving Bremen looking to build on last week's 3-0 demolition of Bayern Munich.
Bayern attempt to build on midweek cup win over Borussia Moenchengladbach while injury and international call-ups deprive Hamburg of large chunk of their first-choice defence.
Cologne coach Peter Neururer has no injury or suspension problems. Promoted Duisburg have only taken one point from their last three home games.
